units.source_text: 他的朋友简单的介绍了这位老人。

en.t: His friend briefly introduced the old man.

units.source_text: 老人的确面带傲气，心不在焉的听信辅的问候。

en.t: The old man did indeed wear an arrogant expression, and listened absentmindedly to Shinsuke's greeting.

units.source_text: 然后，在老人转身离开之前，他对信辅说：

en.t: Then, before the old man turned to leave, he said to Shinsuke:

units.source_text: 在昏暗的廊下的确有两张带扶手的椅子并排放着。

en.t: In the dim corridor there were indeed two armchairs set side by side.

units.source_text: 不过，那两张椅子的椅背很高、红色的软垫已经褪色，大概是五十年前的老旧椅子。

en.t: However, those two chairs had very high backs, their red cushions had faded, and they were probably old chairs from fifty years earlier.

units.source_text: 信辅从这两张椅子里看到了整个中下层阶级的贫穷生活。

en.t: In those two chairs, Shinsuke saw the impoverished life of the entire lower-middle class.

units.source_text: 与此同时，他也看得出来他的朋友和他一样，为有这样的父亲感觉羞愧。

en.t: At the same time, he could also see that his friend, like him, felt ashamed to have such a father.

units.source_text: 这件事情在他记忆里留下了深刻的印象。

en.t: This incident left a deep impression in his memory.

units.source_text: 这些思想从此在他心里投下了更多杂乱的阴影。

en.t: From then on, these thoughts cast even more confused shadows in his heart.

units.source_text: 总而言之，他的确是一个退休官吏的儿子。

en.t: In short, he was indeed the son of a retired official.

units.source_text: 和下层阶级的贫穷相比，他不得不忍受虚伪的中下层阶级贫穷。

en.t: Compared with the poverty of the lower class, he had to endure the false poverty of the lower-middle class.
